title: Harden SCHC ACK/control APIs against invalid runtime input types
description: Robustness codereview found public ACK/control parsing and serialization paths do not consistently enforce exact bytes/integer runtime types. Ack.from_bytes and FragmentSender.handle_ack_bytes can accept mutable bytes-like objects or raise raw TypeError for lists/strings; ack_request/Fragment/Ack window and related fields accept bool via equality. Make public wire APIs fail predictably with FragmentError, reject bool/type confusion, preserve canonical valid encodings, add focused regression tests, and run 3x post-fix review.
notes: Security review independently confirmed mutable bytearray/memoryview ACK buffers could cross the auth/parser boundary; current fix now rejects non-bytes before dispatch and Ack parsing.
